content.text:
Pickiness about greens is really common at 28 months, and it usually eases with low-pressure exposure. Put a tiny bit of something green on his plate next to foods he already likes, and don't ask him to eat it. Let him ignore it, poke it, or watch you eat yours. It can take a lot of calm tries before a toddler actually tastes it. Letting him wash or tear the leaves, or pick one at the store, also helps.

Also, I can try signing a child up on a program's registration page once you say yes. I used to tell you I couldn't.
